The Pro Platinum also packs features once thought possible only on much larger platforms into a compact quadcopter that is snappy agile and captures high-resolution images. The drone features an advanced flight control system that draws on a host of sensors including a ground-facing camera ultrasound GPS dual redundant IMUs and more to keep track of where it is flying in 3D space and even avoid collisions.
